messages:
deploy-bot: Heads-up: initiating soft router evacuation to switch traffic from blue -> green in controlled increments. Plan: 10%, 20%, 30%, 40% with 3m intervals. Health gates: /healthz probe success & p95 < 240ms. Auto-pause on 2 consecutive probe failures. Command: /deploy router v2 --mode soft-evac --steps 10,20,30,40 --probe /healthz

marta: noted. we still want cookie affinity for EU for first 20m, right?

alex: yes, set stickiness=cookie, age-cutoff=7m (older sessions stay on blue), new sessions go to green. avoids mass reassigns.

kevin_ops: drain plan: after each shift run a gentle drain 90s then hold 60s for connection quiesce. lb command snippet: 
```
rb-lbctl traffic-shift --svc router --from blue --to green --pct 10 --grace 90
rb-lbctl wait --svc router --until probes_ok --timeout 180
```

nina: telemetry checklist: ensure router.p95, router.error_rate, lb.active_conn, session.reassign.count on watch. I'll keep dashboard pinned.

deploy-bot: Canary scope: EU-first for step1 (10%), rest global. Change window 2026-03-21T23:30Z->2026-03-21T00:30Z. Rollback triggers: error_rate > 2x baseline OR p95 > 320ms OR sustained probe failures.

marta: adding to release notes: "soft router evacuate; EU cookie stickiness; session pin age 7m; drains 90s+60s"

alex: preflight checks: green serving warm, disks ok, no active infra alerts. Running dry-run of lb commands.

deploy-bot: starting step 1 in 90s. posting updates every step.

deploy-bot: STEP 1 APPLIED -> 10% shifted to green (EU-only). probes 10/10, p95=170ms, error_rate=0.01%. drain on blue started.

kevin_ops: seeing small increase in upstream 502s at us-west-edge-3 (3 events). monitoring. not at trigger level yet.

nina: trace slices show those 502s tied to cache-miss storm during warmup. not systemic.

alex: ok proceed to step 2 after hold.

deploy-bot: STEP 2 APPLIED -> 20% to green. probes 9/10 (1 transient), p95=200ms. auto-pause not hit.

marta: hold 10m before step 3 per change plan. also remind SRE to keep artifact pinned for 30m in case rollback needed.

kevin_ops: enabling verbose logs for the shift window; adding marker IDs to correlate.

deploy-bot: STEP 3 APPLIED -> 30% to green. probes 8/10 briefly then recovered to 10/10. p95 peaked 260ms for ~45s then settled to 210ms. error_rate 0.06%.

nina: spike aligns with a cache eviction triggered by config sync. mitigation: bump memcache TTL in config, rolling out in 5m.

alex: agree. defer final step by 10m until memcache change propagates.

marta: agreed. pause final ramp; update release notes: "final ramp delayed due to cache eviction spike, mitigation in progress"

deploy-bot: auto-pause engaged (manual resume required) due to temporary probe instability. waiting for manual resume.

kevin_ops: memcache TTL change deployed. performing quick synthetic tests. results: p95 back to 190ms, probes 10/10.

marta: resuming final step in 2m. if anything > rollback thresholds we revert to 100% blue.

deploy-bot: RESUMING -> FINAL STEP APPLIED -> 40% to green (total 100% green). final probes 10/10, p95=185ms, error_rate=0.02%. drains completed. change window closed.

alex: marking release DONE. notes include timeline, the transient pause reason, and rollback hook details.

kevin_ops: leaving rollback hooks (pre-approved command) for 90m. rolling logs archived for postmortem if needed.

nina: thanks team. I'll close the watch in 30m if stable.

deploy-bot: deploy summary: soft-evac completed with one automated pause for transient probe instability. no manual rollback. metrics attached to release page.
